reviews.text: Thank you so much for your 5-star rating, Lyn! We appreciate your support and are delighted to know you enjoyed your experience with us. Your satisfaction means a lot to us. Thank you for purchasing Mika & Sammy's Gourmet Pet Treats.

This team of people that have dedicated themselves for our pups nutrition and treats is class A. The best of the best. My dog runs when he knows his treats are coming. He can smell them so he knows the mail is coming for him. He’s a happy boy and I’m a happy Mum knowing everything is healthy for him and made in the USA!! The best of everything and great success to this fabulous team!!
Roxie, pup Mum to Lucky Boy.

I have bought the smoked beef marrow bones a few times. My dog loves them. It keeps him busy a long time. Even after he’s gotten all the good stuff off, and he’s not as interested in it, I stuff them with a few tablespoons of canned dog food and freeze it. He loves it all over again. They also have good customer serve. I had a small issue with my account. I emailed them and they responded the next day. They were very helpful.

Our Big Pitty girl loves these bones(smoked marrow)!!! She knows exactly where they're kept & stands there looking up, asking for one!!! If you've been busy & want to treat your dog for time unspent, then I highly recommend these products!!! Oh & they like to reward customers who have  subscriptions, thank you Mika & Sammy!!

Our grand dog went Absolutely crazy over this gourmet bone! He loved it so much that he carried it around looking for the perfect spot to bury his treasure!🐶 But temptation was just too much! He went back, dug it up and enjoyed every bite. One very happy spoiled grand dog.Highly recommended!!🐕❤️🐕❤️ …
Our pup loves your braided bully sticks!  Thanks for the tip to microwave the  ends for a couple minutes to make popcorn!!

I bought some of the big marrow bones for my senior.

She loved them, she even growled at me when I tried to take it.

Afterwards I discovered my vet felt she was a bit too old for hard bones due to her bad teeth.

The customer service was LOVELY..so friendly polite and patient. They cancelled my subscription for me easily.

I gave the bones to a neighbor for her wiener dogs and they loved them too.

The neighbor told me she bought some MORE treats from their website.
Our Doberman looks forward to her box of bones every month! She smells them thru the box! They keep her busy for hours! Great product!
Best bone ever, keeps Louie busy for hours and he hasn’t even got the marrow out yet!

Don't order from these thieves, I ordered a package for 99.00 and didn't receive everything on the list and now they won't answer my emails!! Pretty sad for a family business!! They still haven't sent me my purchased items but said they would on Sept 15th. Tomorrow I contact the BBB and my credit card company for a refund!!
My dog loves the cow and pig ears and the Bully sticks. They don't splinter and they last a while keeping her occupied. The owners are  nice and friendly.
We love all products from Mika and Sammy’s. The bones are great for aggressive chewers and are safe and long lasting. Worth the money and they have great sales/promotions. 10/10 customer service too!

Hi Enma, this is Erik, the owner of Mika & Sammy’s. I was concerned to see your rating and would really like to understand what happened. I went through our CRM but wasn’t able to find an order under your name, so I don’t have enough information to look into your experience. Could you please email me at erik@mikaandsammys.com with your contact information and order number? I’d like to reach out to you personally, find out what happened, and do what I can to resolve your concerns.
My German Shepherds lose their minds over this treat!  It keeps them busy fur hours and is helping with dental health.  Two-fur!
Our german shepherd and miniature schnauzer love the large and small bones!! The bones last forever with ZERO splintering!

Floki just recieved his bone and bully stick and man was he happy! I was getting ready to walk him and opened the door and there it was. I brought it in and sat it on the coffee table and immediately he sniffed and started licking the box. He knew it was his! Gave it to him and he is the happiest boy ever! I will definitely be ordering all of his bones and bully sticks from here! Thanks Eddie for the video giving cici hers! That’s what made me buy one for my boy

My dog LOVES these treats! I am very careful with what kinds and brands of bones I give him because splintering and artificial ingredients are a big concern for me. So far, I haven’t experienced any issues with splintering. The bones are long lasting, even for an aggressive chewer and once my dog finally comes up for air after chewing for half and hour, he takes a drink of water and settles in for a nice nap! Love this brand and the customer service is excellent, very helpful and diligent.

Awesome bones, I can’t keep my puppy away from it. We actually have to distract her to take the bone away. Definitely will purchase more bones and other products from this company. Family owned from Philly!
Go Birds!
My grand dog loved his bone and I had a question and the customer service was on point. I feel like there’s not a lot of that anymore. Great job Mike and Sammy!!!
Great products, outstanding customer service and fast shipping. We've been a customer for over 18 months with an average of 5 orders a year.

The bones at Mika & Sammy's speak for themselves.  The dogs love them, and they are safe because they are not cooked.  However, I'd like to speak about the customer service.  Their customer service is remarkable.  I received a torn box (pretty big tear), and the box was brown on one side.  I emailed pictures to Mika & Sammy's to let them know.  I was not asking for anything.  I just wanted them to know how their shipment was received.  They asked me if anything was missing.  I checked and responded that I had received the full amount of bones that I paid for.  For my hassle, they are sending me a new order.  Their response time is also very fast; and, if it takes a day or so to get back to you, they apologize.  I love this company!  Thank you, Mika & Sammy's!!

My Charlie loves these bones. As soon as these bones get into the house he follows me until I open the box. These smell so good. It's as if we are cooking out at home. Charlie is occupied for hours with these bones. Thank you for making something so awesome that does not splinter where I am not concerned that he is gonna get hurt on. These are his favorite treats by far. Great product.

Customer service is amazing and all the treats are delicious according to my dog Luna. She loved the smoked bones and chicken feet and all the other treats she is gotten from Mika & Sammy’s! Items ship fast and always a promotion to get free items added to order. I’m gonna be getting all of luna’s treats from them.

Edit: the owner contacted me to check on George. He has recovered but I am returning the bones. The smell is so powerful that the entire house had to be aired out. But I was still hopeful that our Anatolian shepherd would be happy with it and it would keep him busy while I work from home. After eating all the coating off the bone, he began having awful diarrhea. Despite feeding him chicken and white rice with pumpkin it has lasted 3 days. He only had the bone for about 2-3 hours once.

We bought our dog so many different chew toys, but he goes through them to fast or bones tend to splinter. We thought we would give Mika and Sammy's Gourmet Pet Treats a try. We ordered to see if he would like them. When we received pkg I let him sniff the box and he got so excited. He has been loving his bone since he got  it. We will see how long it lasts . He is a very aggressive chewer. He loves it so much. I would recommend it. So does Bo.

Ordering was easy, I live close to pick it up, staff is polite and very professional,  can not go wrong.

If you live far. They ship.

So worth it.

We signed up for delivery every six weeks, but their subscription practices and customer service left us completely unwilling to do business with them again.

They emailed us at 2 a.m. trying to upsell us on their already overpriced dehydrated treats to qualify for free shipping. Buried at the bottom of that email was the link needed to manage the subscription. Because my login information was tied to another computer, I couldn’t cancel it myself despite trying.

I contacted them directly and explained that our dog had just been confirmed as allergic to chicken and asked them to cancel the order. Instead of helping, they processed it anyway and offered excuse after excuse.

Beyond that, I find their prices excessive for what they sell. The beef liver treats are extremely hard and can break into sharp pieces, and several of their treats struck me as potential choking hazards.

What bothered me most was the complete lack of goodwill. Extenuating circumstances happen, and we gave them a legitimate and truthful reason to cancel. They simply refused to help.

I would never trust this company with my credit card on a subscription. Based on our experience, once they have your payment information, expect to be charged regardless of the circumstances. Customer service is revealed when something goes wrong—and theirs told me everything I needed to know.
The product was amazing, and their customer service is the best I've ever dealt with. Great company.
My pups Loved them!  My golden retriever puppy is in love with them!

My girl, Molly is a husky/pyrenees mix so I got her one of the bigger bones for her recent 5th birthday. She LOVED it! I also got chicken feet and pigs ears. The chicken feet went over very well, and I have not given her a pigs ear, yet. I have shared some of both with my sister and nephew’s dogs, however!  Very pleased with all the treats and I would highly recommend!!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My two Morkies are officially OBSESSED with Mika & Sammy’s! 😂🐾 I’m pretty sure they now believe I exist solely to provide them with treats from this company.

As a dog mom who absolutely spoils her babies, I’m really picky about what I give them, and I love that Mika & Sammy’s puts so much care into what they make. You can tell these aren’t just mass-produced treats thrown into a bag, everything feels thoughtfully made, high quality, and made by people who genuinely understand how much our pets mean to us.

The smoked treats and chews are a HUGE hit in our house. Both of my little Morkies go completely feral the second they see a Mika & Sammy's box. 😂 One of them will literally sit and stare at me like I’ve personally betrayed him if I don’t produce a snack fast enough.

I also love supporting a Philadelphia family-owned business that clearly takes pride in what they do. The quality is fantastic, the treats are clearly made with love, and most importantly, my two spoiled little monsters give Mika & Sammy’s their highest possible rating: they come running every single time.

If you have a picky dog, a spoiled dog, or, like me, a dog who is both picky AND spoiled, you NEED to try Mika & Sammy’s. Your dog will thank you. 🐶❤️

10/10 from me. 11/10 from the Morkies. 🐾🐾
Have a pit bull an it the best bone out there

Thank you, Moh, for your 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are delighted to know you enjoy our treats. Your satisfaction means a lot to us. Thank you for purchasing Mika & Sammy's Gourmet Pet Treats.

Mika & Sammy's Gourmet Pet Treats offers great products backed by phenomenal customer service. Their team is professional, friendly, and clearly committed to quality in everything they do. Highly recommend!

Great product.. I had the privilege of getting a tour of their facilities. Super clean, very organized and a dedicated friendly staff.
Your doggies will love their products.
The products are great.  When Archie gets a pig-ear he is in a trance from start to finish!

I ordered three small marrow bones for my 14 lb rescue dog, Sparkles, a Chihuahua mix. At first, she wasn’t interested at all, and I was so disappointed. reached out to Mika & Sammy’s Customer Service, and they were absolutely wonderful!  They explained that some dogs—especially rescue dogs—just need a little time to figure out something new and shared a few helpful tips.

I’m so happy to say they were right! Sparkles now loves her marrow bones and even carries them around to hide for later. 😊

Excellent customer service, quality products, and people who truly care about their customers and their dogs is something that this small company definitely gets right! I highly recommend Mika & Sammy’s!

My dog has never been more invested in a bone. It’s been hours….we got a small size for a 21 lb dog to provide some context…he didn’t even want to go on his walk tonight because he just wanted to keep chewing (very unlike him)! He didn’t even break off any pieces yet! This bone is incomparable to the other bones I’ve invested my money into and for such a great price. Thank you, Mika and Sammy!!!!

My granddog is a Cane Corso Mastiff named Kain. I work hard for my money to buy this big baby toys. He destroys toys and bones within 15 minutes of receiving them. But NOT these bones!!! They are amazing! And my daughter isn’t running him to the vet to find out “what has he ingested now”. Thank you for this splinter-free, long lasting dinosaur safe, dog bone. Well worth every penny!!
This is the Large bone with a large dog 😂😂
Mandy and Matilda approved. Thank you :)

Our four rhodesian ridgebacks love treats from Mika & Sammy's. The giants bones and pig ears are everyone's fav and they can't get enough chicken feet. The smoke smell also helps create a super high priority treat, making daily training easier and fun. Thank you for creating this opportunity to source real treats for them. They are in love!
I bought the large bone from Mika & Sammy’s Gourmet Pet Treats. It smelled so good and my dog had eaten it clean, Marro is almost gone too. I’ll definitely buy more.

The bone marrow bones, bully sticks and just chicken treat combo box was a huge hit with my dog Baxter.  He loved everything and the best part is he didn’t get sick from it which can happen with other brands.  Worth every penny!

The magic box arrived! It was green and white, yet it held super powers beyond belief! ..it made 3 rambunctious German shepherd's in docile quiet beasts, except for the grinding crunching sounds. It was pure bliss for them, and better yet...for me!! Quiet time!
My girls love these bones! This is the second time buying them, please monitor them carefully because both large bones broke on the edges!! Make sure to have water available, these make them thirsty.

There bones are 💯 worth buying and amazing and smell so good!!! it's nice to have bones that won't splinter in your dogs stomach these are by far the best bones I have bought in years and I will continue to keep buying for my dogs 🙏🏽🩷 …

So I was Skeptical About these bones as most companies will say they don’t splinter and are are 100% natural and No added preservatives and it is never true to as advertised.  However, i saw an ad for Mika and Sammy read their story and I gave it a try because I have three dogs, Brando, Chase, and Bugsy that are aggressive chewers and can demolish bones and most of them splinter where I have to throw them away so I ordered three large bones. They absolutely went nuts for them. They’re still going to town on them days later worth the money spent. Thank you Mika and Sammy.

We LOVE Mika and Sammy’s!! Love supporting a small family business built from the ground up with hard work and HEART! I am a raw feeder and their brand fits right in with my idea of what “should” be fed to promote healthy living for our pups. I also HIGHLY recommend Mika and Sammy’s to all of my dog training clients. In fact, they are the ONLY smoked marrow bone I recommend because they are COLD smoked!! Bones smoked with heat will splinter and dry out and can cause a health risk. Plus, every Graduation gift bag has a few scrumptious Mika and Sammy’s treats to sample as well because I want to not only support a healthy mind in my training clients, but a healthy body as well.
Donna - All4paws Dog Training
And the Teacher’s Furmily - Judge, Chantz, Mazie, Marty and Emmie (the cat) ❤️🐾🐾❤️

Just want to say that Mika and Sammy’s Gourmet Pet Treats are great.  My dog loves them so much I’ve decided to enroll in auto-delivery.  They are the longest lasting bones I’ve found. What’s more, the customer service is first rate.  We received a damaged box, through no fault of Mika and Sammy’s, and they promptly replaced it within under 24 hours of my email.  Thank you.
Ordered multiples times - dog loves the bones and treats- would highly recommend
Best treat I’ve ever bought for my two labs. Now that they’ve had a taste it’s all they can think about (see the box on the table in the first pic).

Thank you for your 5-star rating, Brian! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you enjoyed your experience with us. Our team works hard to provide the best for our furry friends. Thank you for purchasing Mika & Sammy's Gourmet Pet Treats.

If you want quality pet treats for your dog, then go no further then Mika & Sammy’s Gourmet Pet Treats. They are the real deal. Quality in every way and your dog will go nuts over them. Job well done.

My 90 pound American Bully, Tucker, LOVES these bones!! I’m limited in what I can give him to play with, chew on, and sleep on because he eats everything. He’s shreds beds , toys and comforters and consumes the fluffy filling. This behavior has resulted in some veterinary emergencies. I have felt guilty that I can’t give all of the toys he wants (to eat! 😳), but now that I can give him these bones once in a while, I love watching him enjoy them. They are a little bit pricey, but seeing how much he loves them, and realizing that they are safe for him because they won’t splinter, makes them worth the price for me! 🥰
Both Luna and Bella were crazy about these bones. We had some quiet time with these two while they worked on their bone.

Super fast delivery! My pup loves the Pumpkin Chicken toppers (we use them as training treats) and the smoked beef marrow bones are a hit as well (they also smell like a delicious BBQ)! Just placed our second order!!

Thank you, JoEllen, for your 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are delighted to know you enjoyed your experience with us. Our goal is to provide the best for our furry friends, and your satisfaction means a lot to us. Thank you for purchasing Mika & Sammy's Gourmet Pet Treats.

Thank you, Robert, for your excellent rating! We appreciate your support and are delighted to know you enjoyed our treats. Our team works hard to provide the best for your furry friends. Thank you for purchasing Mika & Sammy's Gourmet Pet Treats.
Such a wonderful, trustworthy company for our favorite family members!!! 😉 Love Mika and Sammy’s. …

Well you surprised us! Our Kangal has a bite of PSI 743, the strongest of any dog.

Over the years we have purchased dozens of bahs of dried cow ears from Chewy.com. However, our 11year old Anatolian Shepherd will occasionally be unable to digest them, so we've had to search for something that won't splinter or cause them harm. We've tried chew bones of all types.

Yours brought excitement and long lasting joy!! Once their chew time is finished, we wrap each bone in the paper with their name on it, as directed.

I'll send pictures from when they first received their bones and were allowed to chew outside, to now as they chew in the air conditioning on the Persian rug. Thank you for a great product.

As you can see, we're quite pleased.

Acorn, my Staffordshire Terrier is a habitual chewer of great treats  We started with the cold smoked marrow bones that smell so delicious I almost take them from her!  I first become a customer when I read about the difference of “cold smoked” vs regular bones that splinter  Over the last two years we have expanded our selection to the smoked chicken & duck feet and Yak milk chews, pig ears, jerky and the multi treat packa  Recently I ran out of the smoked chicken feet , so I ran down to the local TSC store and bought another brand. While they were “all natural” they smelled terrible and Acorn was leaving them uneaten all over the house!  I quickly reordered from Mika & Sammy’s and she is a happy pup one again!  The quality of every product is top of the line, great customer service too.
“100% Acorn tested & approved”
Greatest bone you can buy. Marley can't leave it alone, she even took a nap with it, LoL.

I was Very excited for this order. My pup is having some issues and getting older and I thought to give him a big treat. Shipping was okay, however the box came wet all the way through from the bones. I don't think a bone should be having that much moisture that they would go all the way through the paper inside and the box to the outside. Mailman was a bit disgusted and I apologized to him. I purchased the medium size, not sure what they think a medium should be. But quite a bit big for my dog, though my dog grabbed them and ran off anyway. Their mouths open as wide as it goes.
That wet box, well... it stinks, the bones stink. But, bones do stink, but the fake bbq smell thing they brush on isn't pleasant. And I'd rate that a 6, as I can live with it. Far better smelling than bully sticks.
Now that I look through the reviews and saw some of the business owners bad comments, I am reluctant to ever order again. I run a much bigger business and would Never talk to customers that way. There is no such thing as having a bad day when it comes to replying back to someone. Take a break if needed, take a day. Take something calming. Don't treat people badly. I can live with no refund, post that up front. I don't offer refunds. But if I were to be the one to ship out an order wrong, I'd send the proper items and a return label so they could ship me back the items they didn't order.
Anyway, I didn't rate them at all on their responses to reviews, just made me shocked and reluctant.

My review is solely based on the bones. The medium bone seems more like a cut up large bone. Which doesn't make a true medium. The way the box came in. What and why is it wet? If this is normal, why isn't it mentioned? Paperwork says leave them in the box with good airflow... but should they sit in the wet paper? I just don't know what to do now.

The reason I gave 3 stars is, I had 2 very happy dogs. My dogs are now 10 and I would tell people to have their dogs teeth checked annually if you aren't brushing their teeth 5 to 7 times a week. Tooth decay can be just as big of an issue for dogs, animals as they are for humans. They were both so exhausted from chewing on the bones I had to take them away for the night. They panted and laid on their side on the cold floor for over a half hour.... they are quite happy. And will be happy to have them again tomorrow.

The best bones out there! My girl loves her smoked marrow bones . They do not splinter and she is a 110 pound Cane Corso who can chew through anything. The dinosaur bone was a great investment for her many days of chewing, and the chicken cheese treats were a hit!

We wi definitely be ordering more in the future!
Lucy is waiting patiently for her treats. She and her cousins LOVE Mika and Sammy’s treats
My dogs are heavy chewers and picky about treats. I gave them each a bone an hour ago and they love them. Haven’t put them down

I recently received a box of smoked bully sticks, smoked chicken feet, and three smoked beef marrow bones from Mika and Sammy’s Gourmet Pet Treats. My three Chihuahuas absolutely loved them! The aroma from the smoked beef marrow bones was so good when I opened the box that you would almost want to eat them yourself.

This family-owned business truly delivers on its promises. The quality of their products is outstanding, and what they describe in their commercials is exactly what they produce. It’s clear they care about providing healthy, high-quality treats for our pets. I highly recommend them!

— A very happy customer and three very happy Chihuahuas 🐾❤️

I have 2 60+ pound Bernedoodles who are obsessed with these bones! We order a box of 10 large bones every month and try to space them out to last the entire month. They do smell smoky and they do have a residue on them, but we just keep them in the kitchen off the carpets and beds until the residue comes off which usually is about 15 minutes but these bones last them almost a week each. We’ve had great customer Service experience With Eric And we do the subscribe and save so our order is delivered to our door every month. We have never seen a bone splinter nor have our dogs had any issues with these bones. They literally spent hours the first day that we get them.. They are like doggy pacifiers lol

Thank you, Leeann, for your wonderful rating! We appreciate your support and are delighted to know you enjoyed your experience with us. Our team is dedicated to providing the best for our furry friends. Thank you for purchasing Mika & Sammy's Gourmet Pet Treats.

After a lot of research, I decided to give Mika & Sammy's a try... So happy that I did!  A quality product, friendly customer service and quick shipping!  Plus you get to support a small family owned business who actually cares about the product they're putting out into the world.  Give them a shot... you won't be disappointed and your pup with be wagging their tail for hours!
Mika & Sammy’s are the REAL DEAL!!! I will be a lifelong customer for our GSD.  The Smoked Beef Marrow Bone is a huge hit, and we’ll be trying the rest of their menu!!
Mika & Sammy’s bones are Jetty’s favorite treat.  He’s been carrying the same bone in his mouth sine this morning.  He’s 23lbs and loves the small and medium bones.

My 115 pound pitbull Prince loves his meaty bone. It’s very durable and long lasting, and it smells so good ! You can smell the smoke flavor as soon as you open the package. It’s my first time purchasing and I will be buying more. It’s keeping my boy distracted &  busy and out of puppy trouble. Don’t second guess making your purchase just buy it, your pup will not be disappointed !! It’s worth every cent : )

Absolutely amazing dog bones! Our Lab is always so excited with she gets her YakCheese chews or one of her slow smoked bones. Always running specials when I buy bones, so we typically are receiving complimentary bones or chews in every order! Also superior customer service! Will continue to be a long time customer. Highly recommend!

Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Kellen! We appreciate your support and are glad to have you as a customer. Your satisfaction means a lot to us. Thank you for purchasing Mika & Sammy's Gourmet Pet Treats.

Love love love this company and what they do! I have a 5 month old puppy and bought the bully sticks.  Best purchase it satisfies his chewing is long lasting safe, won't splinter.  Will continue to buy them! Highly recommend them. Must buy to keep pups happy!

Terrible reviews across multiple platforms.  They only respond to only certain feedback - well, read the other 1 star Google reviews.  They actually DEMAND you ship back your used and unused products for a refund.  Which is asinine if they're reselling defective products.  PETA anyone?

Shop elsewhere if you care about pets and your finances.

I am so happy to support a family-run business like Mika & Sammy’s Gourmet Pet Treats. Also located in PA, shipping was very fast. My two dogs (a boxer and GS) absolutely love everything we’ve tried and I believe I’ve placed 3 orders already!

We’ve had no GI upset from any of the products and my GS has a very sensitive stomach.

Everything has arrived fresh and packaged perfectly. Communication is quick and easy. Promotions are available all of the time. And while the price may be stiff, I would rather pay a little more for the highest quality for my fur babies!
I 100% recommend to all of my fellow fur families out there!

Excellent, natural, great tasting treats! Before my previous dog passed away, he stopped eating his dog food. We started feeding him cooked chicken. He eventually stopped eating this too. But he continued to eat these gourmet treats until his last day. Our current dog loves the treats too!

I just received my first, but not last, order of marrow bones from Mika and Sammy. My two Rhodesian Ridgebacks absolutely LOVE them. Kwami and Zahra kept busy with the bones for about an hour and a half. If you do try these Marrow Bones your dogs will love them.

Mika & Sammy's treats sends our fur babies into a frenzy that's hysterical! Service and shipping is amazingly fast. We have a subscription that keeps them coming and heaven forbid we miss a shipment. Dealing with a dogs side eye is not cool. 🤣 Found them on Facebook many months ago and highly recommend their product. Better than the garbage crap you buy at the store that sends them to the vet. Don't do your kids dirty and feed them garbage. Treat them with Mikas products. Your babies will love you for it!

My dogs were BEYOND THRILLED when they got these bones. It was a win-win. They were sooo happy and so was I. I didn’t have to worry about them choking or ingesting a piece of plastic. My golden loves to chew. He will eat anything, so I have to watch him. My mini schnauzer is usually bored after a bite, but he chomped happily til bedtime. He was then back at in the morning. It helps my golden as well with his anxiety. Thank you so much!! We will definitely be repeat customers.

I’ve been looking for a good chew for my big dude who can chew a bully stick in 3 minutes. I ordered these bones after doing some research. As soon as I opened the package I could smell the Smokey beefy goodness! You can tell these are high quality and made with love. They are a little pricey but totally worth it. It kept my boy occupied for 2 hours before I finally made him take a break. This company has a lifetime customer in us!

I bought my boy the bone marrow bone! From the time he took it out of the box he went to chewing! I can say you can tell the difference in quality with these bones! And being this is a family owned business is wonderful! If you love youre fur babies take a minute to check out MIKA & SAMMY GOURMET TREATS!

We ordered chicken feet, bully sticks and a marrow bone for our Birdie. She loved them all! We were very pleased with the quality and shipping was fast as well! We will definitely be repeat customers!

Buddy and Butters absolutely love their bones and dog treats!  Thank you so much!  This mom and pop company delivers amazing products for my two dogs.  Plus they are easy to get in touch with a quick reply.  The prices for the these high quality products are outstanding.  My dogs carry their bones with them wherever they go in the house and also backyard.

Our 3 year old dog loves treats from Mika & Sammy’s. She loves them all but her favorites are the bully sticks and the Himalayan Yak Cheese Chewies! We’ve bought others but the ones from Mike & Sammy’s last longer and must taste better cuz she chews on them for a long time! Glad we tried them! Our dog loves them and she gets so excited to receive “her” package once it’s promptly delivered!

If you’re looking for a true paws-up recommendation, just ask Nutmeg, Ebony, and Gizmo—because they are obsessed with Mika & Sammy treats!

From the moment the bag opens, it’s pure excitement. Tails start wagging instantly, and focus is locked in—no distractions, just anticipation. These treats clearly hit the mark on flavor, because they disappear in seconds every single time.

What really stands out is how eager they are when Mika & Sammy treats come out compared to anything else. Whether it’s training time or just a special reward, these treats turn every moment into a celebration. Even picky days? Not an issue—these are always a yes.

Safe to say, Mika & Sammy have officially earned a permanent spot in our treat rotation. Highly recommended by three very enthusiastic (and very satisfied) taste-testers! 🐾

Absolutely top quality products that my dog can’t get enough of, especially the cold smoked large bones !! Fantastic customer service and just a great local company. 5stars+ 🐾❤️
Ziggy thanks Mika &Sammy’s …

We wanted to replace nylon and plastic bones for our super chewers. I did a quick google search for marrow bones and found Mika & Sammy's. I really like the reviews so I decided to give it a try.  Our dogs loved these!!

On our second order there was problem with one of the bones. Customer service was great!! replaced the bone immediately!!
